# `vox-jsonschema-util`

**Crate:** `vox-jsonschema-util` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Shared JSON Schema compile + validate helpers for CLI, contracts, and tooling.

## Crate Overview

Compile [`serde_json::Value`] JSON Schemas with [`jsonschema`] and validate instances with stable `anyhow` context.

File I/O stays with callers (e.g. `vox_bounded_fs`); this crate only centralizes compile/validate.


## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `codegen` | — |

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `compile_validator` | Build a [`jsonschema::Validator`] from a parsed schema document. |
| `compile_validator_from_utf8` | Compile after reading UTF-8 JSON from `path` (caller-supplied reader for caps / policy). |
| `validate` | Run validation; errors include `context` and the underlying `jsonschema` diagnostic chain. |
